config.name: bxmo-2019-2
config.statement:
Pawns and rooks are placed on a ${n} \times {n}$ chessboard, with at most one piece on each of the ${n}^2$ squares. A rook can see another rook if they are in the same row or column and all squares between them are empty. 

The maximum number of pawns $p$ for which $p$ pawns and $p + {n}$ rooks can be placed on the chessboard in such a way that no two rooks can see each other is ${k}^2$. 

Find a configuration that places ${k}^2$ pawns and ${k}^2 + {n}$ rooks on the board, such that no two rooks can see each other.
config.formatting_instructions:
Output the answer between \verb|\begin{array}{...}| and \verb|\end{array}| inside of $\boxed{...}$. For example, $\boxed{\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{array}}$.
If a square contains a rook, write 2. If a square contains a pawn, write 1. Otherwise, write 0.
